newsitem.title: JORDAN: Jordan dinar overnight rates rise to 6.61 percent.
newsitem.headline: Jordan dinar overnight rates rise to 6.61 percent.

text.p: The weighted average overnight interbank rate on the Jordanian dinar rose to 6.61 percent on Monday from 6.09 percent last Tuesday, the day before a five-day Moslem holiday, the Central Bank said.

It said four banks traded on the market in thirteen reported transactions with a total value of 19.9 million dinars ($28 million). Banks resumed business on Monday after a five-day public holiday to mark the Moslem feast of Eid al-Adha.
